title: Dualisable categories in noncommutative geometry
summary: In this exposition based on a lecture series at the CIMPA School on Operator Algebras and K-theory, 2025, we highlight modern perspectives on noncommutative geometry using dualisable categories. To this end, we show that several categories naturally arising in functional analysis (derived categories of bornological and condensed modules), operator algebras (E-theory) and stable categories (noncommutative motives) are dualisable.
